title: Zettai Karen Children
titleNative: 絶対可憐チルドレン
synopsis: In the future, as people with ESP increase in numbers, so does the possible good and evil they can cause to society. The Japanese government establishes of the Base of Backing ESP Laboratory (BABEL), a special esper organization tasked with dealing with situations that can't be resolved by ordinary means, including dealing with espers engaged in criminal activity. Prodigy Kouichi Minamoto is assigned by BABEL to the task of supervising the most powerful espers in the country, a trio of gifted but mischievous young girls known as "The Children". The Children and Minamoto must deal with several enemy organizations, each with conflicted views regarding the role of espers in the world, including "PANDRA", a cadre of rogue espers determined to wage war against the rest of mankind; "Black Phantom", a mercenary organization who brainwashes espers into living tools of destruction; and the "Normal People", composed solely of non-esper individuals who view espers only as a threat to be vanquished. (Source: Wikipedia) Included one-shot: Volume 1: Zettai Karen Children (pilot)

titleNative: 異世界に落とされた…浄化は基本！＠COMIC
synonyms: Summoned to Another World... Purification Is basic!
synopsis: Akira Tennou, an unremarkable thirty-five-year-old man, gets hit by a truck on his way home from work and, after a brief experience in some mystical limbo, wakes up in a gloomy forest. This forest is beset by a sinister black mist—his memories of his little sister's lectures about fantasy novels tell him that it's probably under an evil curse. He soon encounters one of the forest's residents: an enormous silver wolf. At first the creature is hostile, but he finds that it's been corrupted by the same black mist, and he only needs to cry "Purify!" to banish the curse and heal the wolf. Akira discovers that the residents of the forest are all animals, and once purified, they are far from feral beasts. His newfound magic allows him to speak to his new animal companions; he finds that they are intelligent and the rightful rulers of the forest. Akira decides to explore this new world, purifying the land and its inhabitants as he goes. But the source of the cursed mist can't be far away... (Source: J-Novel Club)

synopsis: Hashi Sarnan is the orphaned son of a ministerial family and lives under the protection of his guardian, his uncle Kiiya. One day, in the old town market, he almost has his wallet stolen by a pickpocket named Shirato. Later, he hides Shirato, who has killed a white man and his ex-wife and fled to the temple, but Shirato, whose conscience has awakened while helping Cernan with the temple's restoration work, is shot and killed by police officers who deliberately pursued him. Witnessing this, Cernan begins to doubt the way his uncles are promoting the modernization of the country through coffee cultivation, and he seeks the advice of Iwanaga, a Japanese economic advisor to the government, and proceeds to cultivate wheat independently. synopsis: Upon awakening, a little girl named Lezay finds herself standing alone in an unfamiliar meadow. In front stands a massive dog. Such a creature had never been seen near home before. At that moment, a conclusion forms that this must be what is called reincarnation into another world. Soon, a band of muscular mercenaries appears, seemingly on a mission to subdue the giant dog. However, it turns out this dog is no ordinary beast, but a divine beast. The divine beast, Ranag, becomes deeply attached to Lezay, the only one it can communicate with. In response, leader Alragia offers to take both Lezay and Ranag under the protection of the mercenary troop...? A little girl, a divine dog, and a mercenary squad. This is a bizarre off-world fantasy with some strange members! (Source: Alpha Manga)
